verdict.rationale: Paychex's own payroll page documents running employee payroll with direct deposits, tax filings and W-2s, and the same page claims fast, accurate payments and 1099 reporting for independent contractors. That shows first-party support for paying both worker types, but the evidence never explicitly says both are paid side by side in a single Paychex Flex workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation that W-2 and 1099 payments run in one unified Flex pay run/platform, contractor payment mechanics (onboarding, payment methods, timing), and independent or hands-on corroboration of contractor payments.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform
